title: Session serialization change
trainingLabel: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Read existing sessions with new code, detect incompatible serializers and silent resets, and gate mixed-version transition and rollback on complete state preservation.
preconditions: One synthetic cart and checkout step in an assumed shared in-memory fixture, satisfying the local S031 prerequisite without claiming a deployed shared store.
The old v1 reader understands schema 1 only.
A browser with JavaScript; no server, accounts, credentials or subscription.
actions: Choose candidate reader, write format and existing-payload evidence.
Check all three read probes and attempt a synthetic transition only if every state field matches.
Roll back after a compatible transition using retained candidate bytes.
Reset to compatible defaults and an untested run while retaining all previous observations.
expectedAssertions: Dual reader plus schema 1 writes preserves 3/3 probes and allows rollback.
A schema-2-only reader or schema 2 writes blocks the transition.
The silent-reset reader exposes cart/step loss as failure, not success.
Unavailable evidence is unknown; malformed JSON is an explicit failure.
Invalid input, wrong-state commands and capacity overruns never mutate results or history.

limits.concurrency: One synchronous operator; no concurrent writers or timing model.
limits.retention: In-memory page lifetime only; reset retains history and does not replenish the action budget.
